profile.headline: Software Engineer @ LoudCrowd
profile.summary:
Senior Product Engineer with a full-stack background and a strong product focus. I’ve spent the last few years at a startup building and scaling customer-facing ecommerce products across frontend, backend, and data.
I enjoy owning problems end to end, working closely with product and design, and turning messy requirements into simple experiences people actually like using. 
Most of my recent work has been in Python, TypeScript, React/Lit, Flask, PostgreSQL, and AWS. I’m especially interested in teams where engineers have real ownership, move quickly, and stay close to the product.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
•Consulted internally with various engineering teams for SharePoint/InfoPath solutions
•Developed tools using Python for automation of data entry into Intel’s inventory database
•Engaged in a wide variety of projects for Intel Austin site operations

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•Developed a new webpage for URHA using ASP.NET, HTML and CSS
•Consulted with the executives of URHA to cater to their needs to the website
•Established the webpage for easy access for the technology officer for long-term usage

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•Developed a new webpage for HiShanghai mobile application using Squarespace.
•Updated the events/places behind the application to provide users fresh content.
•Negotiated and presented to local vendors about advertising their events or venue on the application.

positions.title: LAUNCH Leadership Committee Member
positions.description:
•Executed a leadership conference for UT students
•Developed leadership activities for students to help discover their leadership abilities
•Ensured a high turnout rate by concentrating on publicizing the event
